title: GRC102 Part 3 - Governance Controls Implementation
scope: Control register and verification evidence for the isolated training lab.
important_note: This script records control implementations and verification requirements. It does not change live credentials, patch software, or claim unverified controls are effective.

controls.name: Privileged credential management
controls.implementation: Document credential risk; require strong unique secrets, restrict root access, and avoid storing passwords in scripts.
controls.verification: Configuration review required; this script does not change the live database password.

controls.name: Network segmentation verification
controls.implementation: Keep services on the designated internal lab network and document expected communication paths.
controls.verification: Network is configured as internal; web-to-database connectivity test timed out and requires investigation.

controls.name: Vulnerability and patch management
controls.implementation: Inventory application versions, assess vendor advisories, apply supported security updates, and verify remediation.
controls.verification: Image inventory and patch validation should be completed; this script does not patch the application.

controls.name: Logging and incident evidence
controls.implementation: Retain timestamped test results and review application, database, and security logs.
controls.verification: Simulation JSON log exists and records the observed results.

controls.name: Governance accountability
controls.implementation: Assign an owner, priority, due date, and evidence-based closure test to each finding.
controls.verification: Actions are documented below; operational ownership must be assigned by the organisation.
